title: Nourishing Double Fried Slovakian Cheese Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring crispy fried cheese dumplings with a charred exterior and a cheese-pull interior, perfect for a hangover cure. This halal-friendly recipe incorporates tarragon and a double-fry method inspired by KFC.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potato, crumbly farmer cheese, egg, dried tarragon, salt, and black pepper, mixing well.
Gradually add all purpose flour to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and fry the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned.
Increase the heat to medium high and add the remaining 1 cup of vegetable oil to the pan.
Double fry the dumplings for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
